basic_info.description:
Located in the heart of San Francisco's Portola District, this 1949-built home is brimming with potential. The main level features 2 bedrooms and 1 full bathroom, while the lower level includes a 1-bedroom, 1-bath in-Ylaw unit.  The owners currently occupy the lower level and in-law unit.

With a little creativity and sweat equity, this home can be transformed into a beautifully restored classic or the home of your dreams.

Inside, you'll find a mix of carpet, vinyl/linoleum, and wood flooring. Laundry is conveniently located in the garage, equipped with gas hookups, though the space has been converted into a living area. The property also includes owned solar panels.

Outside, the large lot offers additional structures, including sheds and a workshop perfect for storage or hobbies or build a ADU. The home is also situated near the playgrounds and McLaren Park. 

Don't miss this incredible opportunity to create your ideal space in one of San Franciscos vibrant neighborhoods!
